subject.title: Dispatch ClawSweeper on pull request events

question: Should this repository enable the new `pull_request_target` workflow that forwards ClawSweeper secrets to a SHA-pinned reusable workflow before a live pull-request-event run can be observed?
rationale: The implementation avoids executing pull-request code, but it changes the privileged automation boundary and cannot self-dispatch from this branch before it is on the default branch.

options.title: Approve staged enablement
options.body: Approve the bounded, SHA-pinned workflow and observe a controlled non-draft pull request immediately after enabling it.

options.title: Keep manual dispatch only
options.body: Retain the existing trusted manual workflow until a separately approved staging route can prove event dispatch.

recommendation.title: Approve staged enablement
recommendation.body: Approve the bounded, SHA-pinned workflow and observe a controlled non-draft pull request immediately after enabling it.
